phases: Checker and commitment reader: re-attestation chain in intent_lock_committed; .json Artifact attribution in ledger_commitment
Doctrine and glossary: remediating sealed evidence via intent-lock re-attestation
Remediation: two sealed plans, two plan snapshots, one re-attestation record (walked session), two AMENDMENT entries, explicit force-add staging

limitations: Re-attestation supersedes only the plan side; audit snapshot and audit_hash never change
Lock records are hash-bound by nothing; a coordinated direct edit of record, snapshot and plan still passes intent_lock_committed, as before this phase
AMENDMENT review is by pull-request review, not machine-enforced
non_goals: binding lock records to a ledger commitment
editing historical ledger entries or lock records
exclusions: identity terms in .tpl and .gitignore; lock-record binding gap (follow-ups)
